$comment: Hand corrections applied on top of Make Me a Hanzi's data by tools/build-chars.js. chars.js is generated, so edits made there vanish on the next run; they belong here. Keys are characters, values are the CHARS fields to replace. A field set to null is dropped, which is how an untrustworthy hint gets removed without inventing a replacement for it. Whitespace is tidied automatically, so that never needs an entry here.

了.h: A child swaddled in blankets; compare 子

做.h: Someone 亻 who causes things to happen 故; 故 also provides the pronunciation
